name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Strategy & Digital Marketing Leader — Executive Accounts, Team Development, Performance
summary: Client strategy and digital marketing leader who retained all but one of a 15–20 partner portfolio at Birdeye (~94%, deals $10K–$45K) and contributed to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment at Wix. 15+ years across performance marketing agencies, SaaS, and SMB digital services spanning PPC, SEO, paid media, and marketing automation. Managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists, owning budgets, scope, and delivery, and built the hiring, training, and process work that took a new vertical from proof of concept to a profitable business line.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of service-based businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface client goals, objectives, and market challenges.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and strategic recommendations, backed by rigorous tracking across sales enablement, marketing, and operations.
Build performance dashboards tracking lead generation, funnel progression, campaign ROI, and pipeline velocity, delivering insights to executive leadership.
Optimized a client's Google Ads account, cutting spam and low-quality leads and improving click-through quality, then diagnosed on-site CRO as the remaining conversion bottleneck.
Conduct technical SEO audits, keyword gap analyses, and competitor research, implementing fixes directly inside client CMS platforms.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand retainer scope, recommending and scoping complementary services aligned with client objectives.
Architect and deploy AI-driven marketing systems that automate lead enrichment, outreach, and appointment booking, advancing measurement and reporting through automation.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Led integrated digital marketing strategy across inbound, paid media, and content, coordinating execution across internal creative, media, and analytics teams.
Built campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI, CAC, LTV, and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and quarterly business reviews.
Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.
Produced high-converting campaign assets, including landing pages, complex email sequences, and conversion-focused copy, improving lead generation and pipeline.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15–20 reseller partners with deal sizes of roughly $10K–$45K, retaining all but one (~94% retention).
Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows, equipping them to communicate product value.
Analyzed partner utilization and engagement metrics to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Developed scalable communication workflows and automated product-training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built and refined internal processes at a performance marketing agency that improved reporting accuracy, reduced handoff errors, and strengthened cross-team alignment.
Analyzed campaign performance data and translated results into optimization recommendations across paid media and creative.
Ran client accounts end to end, covering campaign execution, performance reporting, and cross-team communication.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists, overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.

Drove team initiatives and process improvements for a brand-new vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and training of new hires and developing sales training for tenured account executives.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and a 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets.
Led digital growth consultations aligning site architecture, inbound marketing, and SEO best practices to improve client traffic and conversion.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-Suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Escalated issues to leadership early and mitigated account-level risk with direct strategic guidance.
Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps for effectively the full tenure, holding that ranking while quota roughly doubled.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science — Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate — Google / Coursera (Sept 2024)
